about.title: About the Company
about.paragraph1: BrandDESIGN was founded on many years of experience to help make your brand stand out. We specialise in digital large-format printing, cut graphics and signage, and we are based in Brno.
about.paragraph2: We have long worked with companies on graphics for trade fairs, exhibitions and congresses, not only in the Czech Republic but also around the world. We create car and shop window wraps, produce 3D logos and provide textile printing. We handle your advertising from concept and design through production all the way to installation.

banner.title: Together we will find the right solution for you

services.title: What we offer
services.subtitle: Discover our portfolio of successful projects and branding solutions.

printing.title: Printing / Production
printing.description: Our technology allows us to meet state-of-the-art standards. We provide production and digital printing of stickers, contour cutting, full-coverage printing of films, posters and banners. We also produce 3D logos and offer textile printing.

expositions.title: Expositions
expositions.description: We provide a complete service from the design and production of trade fair graphics to on-site installation worldwide.

sticks.title: Sticks
sticks.description: We create large-scale advertising graphics – car, vehicle and shop window stickers – from graphic design through to installation. Interested in a wrap in Brno? Contact us.

partners.text: We actively cooperate with Mistry Mont s.r.o.
